description: Put a project in a group of projects — out of the one it was in — or, with no 'group', in none. Whose names the project offers when somebody picks a person changes at once. The company's administrator only; a project's own owner cannot. In the company's journal.

group.description: The group's name or id; leave out for no group.

name: move_project_to_group
